events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Cane Creek Night: Best Decorated Bike
events.description: Best decorated bikes win. Streamers, lights, pool noodles, handlebar bouquets: anything goes as long as your bike is still safe to ride.

events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Conative MTB Apparel Night: Reverse Handicap
events.description: Reverse handicap race - everyone chooses a random number at registration and subtracts it from their race position at the finish. Lowest number wins!

events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Fox Factory Night: Best Costume
events.description: Halloween-week party. Show up in your best costume and race in it (safely!). Best costumes win. Raffle benefits local trails.
